<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/emails/activity"}
#docs
`delivered` counts messages a real relay accepted (smtp/esp); `not_delivered` counts messages marked `sent` that the console sink carried, or that predate the `transport` column. They are reported separately and must not be summed — `status: "sent"` alone is not a delivery claim.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `window_days` | `integer` | no | How many days back to count. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `email_activity`. One of `email_activity`. |
| `window_days` | `integer` | How many days back the counts cover. |
| `delivered` | `integer` | Number of emails delivered in the window. |
| `not_delivered` | `integer` | Number of emails that were not delivered in the window. |
| `pending` | `integer` | Number of emails still waiting to be sent. |
| `failed` | `integer` | Gave up after the retry budget on an inconclusive error (relay down, timeout) — usually a problem at our end. |
| `bounced` | `integer` | The relay permanently refused the address (SMTP 5xx). Terminal on the first attempt, never retried — a bad-address problem, which is why it is not folded into `failed`. |
| `last_sent_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the last email was sent (ISO-8601 UTC), or null. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such business |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/emails/activity" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
